about: The village's quests, its people's talk, what can be carried and the switches, written against the place's own files: the crowd file's resident and wanderers, the nav graph's places, the clips file's bellcote. The quest plugin (plugins/quest/quest.sim.ts) says every part.

stages.1: Agnes wants the evening bell rung. The rope hangs in the chapel loft.
stages.2: The bell is ringing. Tell Agnes.

stages.1: Osric has mended Maud's pot. Take it to her; she goes about the houses.
stages.2: Maud has her pot back. Tell Osric.
stages.3: Maud has her pot, and Osric knows it.

stages.1: Fetch Maud a loaf from the shelf behind the bakehouse counter.

lines.say: Mind the step, dear. These old legs have walked this village sixty years.
You there. My knees won't take the chapel stair today, and the evening bell wants ringing. Would you pull the rope for me?
Bless you. The rope hangs in the loft, up the stair at the back.
The rope's up in the chapel loft, dear. Up the stair at the back.
I heard it! Sweet as ever. Here, for your trouble.
You haul on the rope, and up in the bellcote the bells swing out.
You catch the rope, and the bells fall still.
You haul on the rope, and up in the bellcote the bells swing out for evening.
Can't stop. The fire won't keep.
Maud's cooking pot. Cracked clean through, and I've brazed it whole. I've no time to walk it over. Will you take it?
She wanders, Maud. You'll find her about the houses.
Maud's still waiting on that pot.
She has it? Good. Here, that's yours.
Morning. Or is it evening. One loses track.
Is that my pot? Oh, Osric's a marvel.
Not a drip from it now. Tell Osric I'm grateful.
I've a pot and nothing to put in it. Would you fetch me a loaf from the bakehouse?
The baker leaves them on the shelf behind the counter.
The shelf behind the bakehouse counter, love.
You found one!
Warm still. Thank you, love. Take a penny.
Nothing on the shelf but flour dust.
One loaf left at the back of the shelf. You take it.
